objective: update agents.md/GEMINI.md so the agent treats lexicon validation as a governed workflow, and create a new lexicon_validation_registry.json file

section_to_add.heading: ## Lexicon Validation Program
content: The agent MUST treat the lexicon as a testable operational system, not merely a glossary.
For any canonical term used in a research claim, the agent MUST check whether the term has an entry in lexicon_validation_registry.json.
If no registry entry exists, the term is UNVERIFIED and must be added to the registry with status L0 or GAP_OPEN.
A term may be verified by role rather than globally. Example: residue may be L3 as an admissibility gate while still L1 as memory trace.
The agent MUST NOT mark a term globally verified unless all listed roles have achieved L3 or have documented scope limits.
Definitions MUST remain humble: validation means the term is operationally supported inside tested models, not metaphysically proven.
All lexicon updates MUST preserve canonical names and aliases. Do not delete or rename canonical terms without explicit user approval.

new_step.name: Lexicon Resolve & Validate
rules: If term is missing or weakly supported, create a validation plan before claiming it as grounded.
If the term appears in lexicon_gap_queue.json, preserve gap status unless the current run closes a specific role.

add_to_governance.heading: ### Lexicon Claim Rules
rules: L0: term exists but has no operational test.
L1: term has one model or one run supporting one operational role.
L2: term has multi-model agreement but lacks full robustness or falsification.
L3: term has multi-model, multi-seed, falsification-passed support for a specific operational role.
A paper may say 'term-role verified at L3' only for the exact tested role.
If a claim uses an unverified term, conclusion must say 'proposed interpretation' rather than 'supported definition'.

evidence_levels.L1: single model or single-run operational support
evidence_levels.L2: multi-model agreement, incomplete robustness or falsification

classification_rules.partially_verified: L1 or L2 for one or more roles
classification_rules.gap_open: definition unclear, role untested, or evidence contradictory
classification_rules.deprecated: term should not be used without user approval

residue_gated_filter.operational_definition: Fraction of candidate continuations or updates accepted under current gating conditions.
known_limits: CA residue is inhibitory under current implementation.
FSA residue is a scalar gating requirement, not full physical memory.
This verifies filtering behavior, not full structure preservation.

admissibility_gate.operational_definition: Accumulated state variable that reduces admissible continuation under gating rules.
known_limits: Validated as gate/filter, not yet fully validated as historical structural memory.

candidate_vs_admissible_continuation.operational_definition: A proposed update or transition, only some of which are accepted by admissibility rules.
known_limits: Continuation measured as activity/non-halting only; temporal/process interpretation remains broader.
